# netactuate_vpc_ip_reservations (Data Source)

Reads VPC Ip Reservations visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_ip_reservations" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID.

### Read-Only

- `gateways` (String) Gateway IP reservations as compact JSON.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interfaces` (String) Interface IP reservations as compact JSON.
- `vms` (String) VM IP reservations as compact JSON.
